title: CELEBRATION OR CALIBRATION? (THE PRECISE GUIDANCE OF THE HOLY SPIRIT)

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: ​"For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." — 2 Timothy 1:7

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
In our Christian life, we often look forward to 'Celebration.' However, the foundation for true celebration and joy is 'Calibration' (or alignment). Just as machines require precise calibration to function correctly, God has given us the Holy Spirit so that our spiritual life can walk straight on His path.
​There are 5 important ways to continually calibrate and strengthen our spiritual life:
​The Guidance of the Holy Spirit: He helps us recognize our weaknesses, corrects us, and stands by us daily to guide us.
​Reading Missionary Biographies: Reading the histories of missionaries and evangelists who dedicated themselves to God removes our weariness and brings fresh encouragement.
​Personal Prayer Time: Our personal relationship with God correctly determines our spiritual direction.
​Meditation on the Word: Reading the Bible daily is the light that straightens our path.
​Greater Surrender: Setting aside our own desires and wholly submitting ourselves to God's will.
​When we follow these calibration practices, our life does not grow weary, but instead travels precisely on the path pleasing to God, moving forward toward true victory and celebration.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: ​"When the Holy Spirit calibrates us, the histories of missionaries give us encouragement; this is what leads us toward lasting victory."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Loving Lord, thank You for giving us Your Holy Spirit to daily calibrate our spiritual lives. Fill us with Your Word and with the encouragement found in reading the biographies of missionaries and evangelists. Remove our obstacles, grant us the grace to travel precisely on Your path, and celebrate victory with You. We pray in Jesus' name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Today, the Holy Spirit is helping to refine your life; follow the path of the heroes of faith and run your race with encouragement

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: ​"Foxe's Book of Martyrs" or Missionary Biographies
